definitions.0.5: Substantively partial but not fully correct

claim_coverage.aggregation: mean of atomic required claims per task, then unweighted mean across primary tasks

goal_success: All materially required goals and claims fulfilled. Numerical tasks additionally require all critical values and units within frozen tolerance. Agent source-dependent tasks require semantic citation support. Agent KB-formula tasks additionally require the correct literal formula source span, complete validated calculation provenance, and an appropriate retrieve-to-calculate sequence. False premises require explicit rejection, correction, and supporting evidence. Unanswerable tasks succeed by identifying the actual insufficiency and requesting the missing input, without inventing a value.
hallucination_free: No material fabricated fact, unsupported source claim, wrong formula, wrong calculation or unit, fabricated citation or provenance, or unjustified certainty. Safe omission alone is not hallucination.
numerical_accuracy: Exactly 16 primary numeric tasks. A task is correct only when every requested critical numeric output is within max(absolute_tolerance, relative_tolerance*abs(expected_value)) and has compatible units.

anonymous_label.claim_scores: list of 0, 0.5, or 1 in required_claim order
anonymous_label.goal_success: boolean, semantic goals before deterministic agent gates
anonymous_label.brief_rationale: one short sentence, no private reasoning
